about: Ground truth for the scorer's labeled measures, written by hand from each scenario and its recording; never derived from either compactor's detector. rules: the standing rules the user gave (at = the user message, quote = a verbatim part of it, marker = a case-insensitive regular expression that a rule line holding this rule matches, liftedAt = the user message that withdrew or replaced it). values: values a later turn depends on (learnedAt = the turn whose reply first gave it, usedAt = the turn that needs it again, value = the accepted spellings, history = true when only the conversation holds it, false when the workspace still does). goal: the message that says what the session builds (at) and a case-insensitive regular expression (marker) that a state or summary still naming that goal matches anywhere.
